hooks.name: Terraform non-ASCII guard on save
hooks.description: Warns when a saved .tf file contains a non-ASCII character. If it lands in a description/name/tag VALUE, terraform apply fails at create time even though validate passes (see .kiro/steering/aws-knowledge.md). Prevents a documented partial-apply hazard.

action.command: f=$(python3 -c "import sys,json;print(json.load(sys.stdin).get('filePath',''))" 2>/dev/null); [ -z "$f" ] && exit 0; [ -f "$f" ] || exit 0; if LC_ALL=C grep -nP "[^\x00-\x7F]" "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "WARNING non-ASCII char in $f. If it is in a description/name/tag VALUE, terraform apply will fail at create time (validate will NOT catch it). Replace em/en-dash->-, arrow->-> , smart quotes->double/single, ellipsis->... , x-sign->x. See .kiro/steering/aws-knowledge.md." >&2; LC_ALL=C grep -nP "[^\x00-\x7F]" "$f" >&2; fi; exit 0
